_help: The agency-wide monthly newsletter, THE LINK, shown on the Events & News page (/events). This is NOT the Arroyo Chamiso (Outreach) newsletter, which is in newsletter.json. To post a new issue: put the front and back page images in public/assets/newsletters/, then change the label, headline, paragraphs and file names below. Older issues go in the "archive" list (same fields as the Outreach newsletter: label, thumb, front, back, pdf; newest first) and appear under "Past issues" — see the _help line in newsletter.json for the steps. Set show to false to hide the whole section.
